title: EmbeddGAN: A Novel GAN Framework Using an Embedding Network and Gini Distance Correlation
abstract: arXiv:2609.22508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) have demonstrated strong performance in generating high-quality synthetic data. However, they are limited by no formal guarantees regarding convergence and the effectiveness of the learning process. In practice, this leads to training instability, mode collapse, and sensitivity to hyperparameters. To address this, we propose EmbeddGAN, a novel adversarial training framework based on a dependence-based objective. Instead of relying on a discriminator that classifies samples as real or fake, EmbeddGAN introduces an embedding network that learns a representation in which statistical dependence between samples and their real/fake labels is maximized, while the generator is trained to minimize this dependence. translated_title: EmbeddGAN：一种使用嵌入网络与基尼距离相关性的新型GAN框架
translated_abstract: 生成对抗网络（GANs）在生成高质量合成数据方面已展现出强大的性能。然而，它们受限于在收敛性和学习过程有效性方面缺乏形式化的理论保证。在实践中，这导致了训练不稳定、模式崩溃以及对超参数的敏感性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了EmbeddGAN，一种基于依赖性目标的新型对抗训练框架。EmbeddGAN不再依赖将样本分类为真实或虚假的判别器，而是引入了一个嵌入网络，该网络学习一种表示，使得样本与其真实/虚假标签之间的统计依赖性被最大化，而生成器则被训练来最小化这种依赖性。该目标通过基尼距离相关性（gCor）来实现，当且仅当嵌入与真实/虚假标签在统计上独立时，gCor等于零。最小化该目标……
tldr: EmbeddGAN提出了一种新型GAN训练框架，用嵌入网络结合基尼距离相关性替代传统判别器，通过最大化与最小化样本和真假标签之间的统计依赖性来进行对抗训练，从而解决GAN训练不稳定和模式崩溃的问题。
en_tdlr: EmbeddGAN is a novel GAN framework that replaces the discriminator with an embedding network based on Gini distance correlation, adversarially maximizing and minimizing the statistical dependence between samples and real/fake labels to address training instability and mode collapse.
